page.title: Knowledge
page.description: The governed source of truth shared by your team and agents

hero.title: Turn what your business knows into context every agent can safely use.
hero.description: Draft with humans or AI, review changes, and publish immutable releases. Production workflows only consume an approved snapshot.

business.title: Business context
business.description: Positioning, offers, ICPs, buyer personas, exclusions, proof, and canonical sources.
business.draft_policy: Draft changes never reach production agents

contract.title: Knowledge contract
contract.description: How shared context moves from conversation to production
contract.propose_description: People edit fields directly; AI submits typed, reviewable proposals.
contract.review_description: Concurrent edits are detected before a change can be applied.
contract.publish_description: Owner or Admin creates an immutable production snapshot.
contract.consume_description: Agents use the published business context.

signals.releases_empty: Publish the first approved business context.
signals.proposals_description: AI suggestions wait here until a human accepts or rejects them.
signals.sources_description: Evidence makes positioning and targeting decisions traceable.
